note: EP01 5-second look test (line 01), review fixes applied. Builders: engine/episodes/ep01_test5.js (re-exported by episodes/ep01/test5.js, keyed by "shot"). Times are frame-snapped (frame = round(t*60)). Board: test5_board.md, review: test5_review.md.

params.beat: the world: a gnome face (bright creature ECU, TF opener), snap pull-back to every lawn of the night street, every gnome facing its house (= the lens)
params.angle: gnome eye level (face to the lens) -> high 3/4 from the porches

set.gnomes: 1-2 per lawn on side A (bed0 + lawn0, family variants, lod mid/low; Grandpa preset at A3.bed0), bed0 on side B; the opener gnome (family variant 1, lod hero) at A3.lawn2; all face their houses (slot yaw), lanterns UNLIT

moon.note: behind the opener gnome's hat on frame 0

start.note: ECU of the gnome face from its house side (bible 7.4 opener: TF frame 0 is a bright creature ECU); warm 2.8 cd spill from the house behind the lens as the face key

end.note: porch-out view from above the hero door: the whole family of lawn gnomes faces the lens, the gate, the street with lit lamps and the houses across (their gnomes facing their own houses)

move.ease: 0.8*outExpo + 0.2*outQuad (half done at 0.1 s, still moving at the cut)

push.note: layered on the move so the shot never settles

sparkles.look: TF soft fat 6-8-point snowflakes: sharpness 7, core 0.75, radialGlow underlay 0.55x at 0.5, brightness 2.0

events.what: snap pull-back at full speed on frame 0
events.sfx: W1 airy whoosh (peak 0.12 s) + A1 crickets bed starts

params.beat: grandparents: an old couple on a porch swing

set.builder: hero lot A1 porch, night (sets.buildLawnCloseup, or buildStreet hero house porch "full" if the swing does not fit the centre porch)
set.swing: NEW PROP: slatted wooden bench 5.5 x 1.6 studs, seat top 1.5 above the deck, back 1.6 tall, two chains to the porch ceiling, painted white (#e9e4da) or the deck wood; fallback: two rockingChair props side by side
set.dressing: front door, lit front window (warm) behind them, wall lantern lit, potted plant, porch rail, Grandpa-gnome NOT visible

params.light: porchGlow: warm face key #ffc49a 3.0 cd upper front-left, hemisphere 0.95, cool key 0.7 as fill, lanterns lit 3 cd (glass + halo)
params.post: porch (warm skin): temperature -3, tint 4, shadows #3e1420, highlights #f0d2e0, outWhite #e9d4ee

camera.note: front-left 3/4 (Grandma near/left, Grandpa right), ~8 deg down, aimed at the midpoint between the heads; a white spindle rail 3.4 studs in front of the heads hides the seated legs (PN 2.5 s); the porch open end shows the night side yard at frame right

anim.swing: sway +-2.5 deg at 0.45 Hz about the chain pivots (riders rigid on the seat); humans hold the sit pose
anim.riders: turned 8.6 deg toward each other, inner hands together

sparkles.look: TF soft fat 6-8-point snowflakes: sharpness 7, core 0.75, radialGlow underlay 0.55x at 0.5, brightness 2.0

params.beat: don't die: Grandma, perfectly content; her glasses glint on "die"

set.builder: same porch as s02 (same swing, same light)
set.dressing: lit window + wall lantern behind her shoulder, navy edge of Grandpa's cardigan at frame right

camera.pos: Grandma's head centre + 3.2 studs along her facing rotated +20 deg (same side of the axis as s02), y = head centre + 0.05
camera.target: head centre - 0.35 studs (face in the upper 30-40%)

glint.what: one big 4-point star glint on her right lens rim: tex.sparkle points 4, colour #f4ecff, 0 -> 110 px in 3 frames, back to 0 by +16 frames, rotation 0 -> 25 deg; no sound

sparkles.look: TF soft fat 6-8-point snowflakes: sharpness 7, core 0.75, radialGlow underlay 0.55x at 0.5, brightness 2.0

anim.swing: held still in this shot (sway 0) so the push reads

params.beat: they turn into: a sparkle burst on "turn", both snap into gnomes on the swing

set.builder: same porch and swing as s02

cast.place: standing on the seat at x -1.05 studs, turned +15 deg toward Grandpa, x1.35
standing on the seat at x +1.05 studs, turned -15 deg toward Grandma, x1.35, unlit lantern

camera.note: centred low MS (TF transformation shots 36.3 / 109.7 s): both heads inside before the snap, the two gnomes together and centred after it

anim.gnomes: K.gnomeIdle micro sway; eyes open, gaze at the lens

magicDust.what: gold + pink motes and 4-point pink twinkles swirling around the couple, density rising into the burst

burst.what: per grandparent at chest height: 36 sparkles 50-90 px, ring 60 -> 640 px, core 420 px, 14 white/pink streaks 120-260 px (0.25 s), all drawn over the poof
burst.swap: swap on f134 under a 1-frame white-pink flash (screen 0.85, 0.55, 0.3, 0.14, 0.05 over f134-138) and two small cartoon puffs on the gnomes (opaque f134-135, clear in 0.22 s): humans to f133, gnomes from f134

fx.dust_after: the puff motes settle until the cut
fx.magic_grade: from f134 over 8 frames: postPreset magic (warmGlow grade, bloom 0.4 @ 0.9, glow 0.12 #ffd8c8), hemisphere #ffcdb8/#5a2030 1.4; 26 gold/pink motes 14-30 px

sparkles.look: TF soft fat 6-8-point snowflakes: sharpness 7, core 0.75, radialGlow underlay 0.55x at 0.5, brightness 2.0

events.sfx: P1 poof (pop transient 2.240 s) over M1 shimmer swell (from 2.10, peak 2.30)
